title: Closing a workspace and closing a tab are two copies of one mechanism
body:
`Workspace.closing` and `Tab.closing` in `workspace.rs` are separate flags. `close_workspace` and `finish_closing` in `compositor.rs` mark the workspace, `send_close` every client, and remove the workspace once no client remains. `close_tab` and `finish_closing_tab` do the same for a tab. Every site that reacts to a client leaving checks both flags, in order: `toplevel_destroyed`, `remove_pane` and the `commit` handler. `close_tab` already escalates to `close_workspace` when every other tab is closing.

## Proposal

`close_workspace` marks every tab closing. `finish_closing_tab` removes the workspace (sockets, listener, viewer moves) when it removes the last tab. `Workspace.closing` becomes `tabs.iter().all(|tab| tab.closing)`, read only by the picker label. One flag, one finish path and the two-step check at three sites go.

## Open

A workspace whose tabs have already gone must still tear down. Check the path where the last tab closes while a viewer shows the workspace.
close_reason: Landed in 37ef76b. One flag per tab, one finish path in finish_closing, and Workspace::closing() for the picker label. The commit message lists the one visible change: a closing workspace loses each tab as it empties.
